bindings.ASSETS: Static SPA assets served by the Worker.
bindings.DB: Required production D1 database binding named DB; committed database is patro.
bindings.CACHE: Optional KV cache binding used for low-write global reference caching.
bindings.ARCHIVE: Optional R2 bucket binding used as a durable public-reference cache and D1 read fallback.
